about: ADR-0016 second attempt: a fixed question set, written 2026-10-07 BEFORE any run of the two-hop pick (no AI output seen). Read by scripts/eval-question-aware.mjs (its default fixture). Same model and judge as the first run. kinds: passage = about the passage itself; thematic = whole-Bible, where the best verse may sit outside the passage's own cross-references; selection = asked exactly as the TV asks a selected word (askAI.questionForSelection). A pack is a committed pack file or built from the bundled 和合本 + BSB chapter (bookId/chapter/from/to).
